name: Ars Moriendi
storyline:
Two war orphans, Lev and Anne are swept up in the tempest of an Europe on the brink of total war inspired by WW1. A mercenary brother and an officer sister on opposite sides: Russia recovering with difficulty from a pyrrhic victory and Germany in the midst of a socialist revolution with unquenchable thirst for recognition. Unending ambitions for two nations clashing over Poland amidst a royal election.

Control two singular fates in a conflict which slowly erodes the humanity of its participants. Navigate the alliances and the survival of your mercenary troupe battle after battle in quest of honor with Lev; strike behind enemy lines in daring operations as cutthroat as the ongoing political purges with Anne. Tip the scale of their lives and impact on a war ready to consume all on its path.
summary: Ars Moriendi is a muddy and tragic tactical RPG set in a war-torn Europe of the late 19th century, where you control the fate of a brother and sister on opposite sides. Raise powerful heroes into martyrs, unleash modern weaponry on a fully-destructible battlefield, seek glory in death.
